description: This file defines the interface for port isolation functionalities in the RTL8367C switch API, including function declarations for setting and getting port isolation permissions and EFID (embedding function IDs). It contains include guards, includes a related header, and declares external functions.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIsolationPermittedPortmask
methods.description: Sets the permitted port mask for port isolation on a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIsolationPermittedPortmask
methods.description: Retrieves the permitted port mask for port isolation on a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_setAsicPortIsolationEfid
methods.description: Sets the EFID for port isolation on a specified port.

methods.name: rtl8367c_getAsicPortIsolationEfid
methods.description: Retrieves the EFID for port isolation on a specified port.
